sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Pied Pipe was unlocked after [[Sophie Casterwill]] successfully used a flute to lead the [[Gremlow]] [[Titans]] back to their [[Amulet]]. A radiating light from the Amulet changed the flute into the Pied Pipe. {{Source|Gremlow Infestation!}}

After the Huntik team was captured by [[Wilder]]'s team, [[Cherit]] was forced to play the pipe, charming [[Conquistador]] into letting them in to [[Hernán Cortés]]'s vault on the search for [[Umbra]].  Mid-battle, Cherit dropped the Pied Pipe which left Conquistador uncharmed, causing the team to be attacked by the Titan. {{Source|The Power of Umbra}}

full_text:
The Pied Pipe is a magical pipe originally used by the Pied Piper.

History

The Pied Pipe was unlocked after Sophie Casterwill successfully used a flute to lead the Gremlow Titans back to their Amulet. A radiating light from the Amulet changed the flute into the Pied Pipe. [Gremlow Infestation!]

After the Huntik team was captured by Wilder's team, Cherit was forced to play the pipe, charming Conquistador into letting them in to Hernán Cortés's vault on the search for Umbra. Mid-battle, Cherit dropped the Pied Pipe which left Conquistador uncharmed, causing the team to be attacked by the Titan. [The Power of Umbra]

Abilities

When playing a children's song, the fife can enchant any titan who hears its sweet music: it was used to control the titan Conquistador and let the musician into Hernán Cortés's vault of treasures.
